lines.zh: 我拖着步子，走得像在逛。
lines.en: I shuffle along as if out for a stroll.

lines.zh: 帽檐压得低，我看路要靠感觉。
lines.en: My brim sits low, so I walk by feel.

lines.zh: 我腰上挂着什么东西，一晃一晃。
lines.en: Something hangs at my belt, swinging.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙走，帽檐挡住眼。
lines.en: I hug the wall, brim hiding my eyes.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙根走，那儿有阴影。
lines.en: I keep to the wall's shadows.

lines.zh: 我这人走路不响，专挑软地。
lines.en: My steps are quiet. I pick soft ground.

lines.zh: 我从树后绕出来，没人看见。
lines.en: I come out from behind a tree unseen.

lines.zh: 我走到街口，停下数了数。
lines.en: At the street corner I stop and count.

lines.zh: 我半蹲着走，身子压得很低。
lines.en: I walk half crouched, keeping low.
I move step by step, unhurried.

lines.zh: 我把背后的东西往上提了提。
lines.en: I hitch up what's on my back.

lines.zh: 绕到上风处，那儿气味不散。
lines.en: I circle upwind where the scent won't carry.

lines.zh: 我最后躲在一垛草后面。
lines.en: I end up behind a haystack.
The whole way I've been measuring distance.
I squat with my hands on my knees.
I push my brim up a little.

lines.zh: 我在等一个背对我的时刻。
lines.en: I'm waiting for someone to turn their back.

lines.zh: 我把手里的东西掂了掂。
lines.en: I weigh the thing in my hand.
I count other people's steps.

lines.zh: 风把草压低了，我也压低。
lines.en: The wind bends the grass, and so do I.
I lick a finger and test the wind.
I'm deciding which side to come from.

lines.zh: 我把鞋子在土里蹭了两下。
lines.en: I scuff my shoes in the dirt.
I smile. No one sees.

lines.zh: 我把腰上的绳子打了个结。
lines.en: I tie a knot in the cord at my belt.
I lean on the wall and shut my eyes a moment.

lines.zh: 我在数路过的有几个人。
lines.en: I'm counting how many pass by.

lines.zh: 我动了动脚，准备随时走。
lines.en: I flex my feet, ready to go at any moment.
My aim with a throw is terrible.
I tip my brim and grin at you.
Don't be nervous. Just looking.

lines.zh: 你腰侧那只口袋装得满。
lines.en: That pouch at your hip is packed full.
Turn your back and I'll be gone.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地、慢慢地往旁边挪。
lines.en: Slowly, slowly, I edge aside.

lines.zh: 你手放在腰上了，我看见了。
lines.en: Your hand's at your waist. I saw.

lines.zh: 你手还没抬，我就贴着你。
lines.en: Your hand's not up and I'm already on you.

lines.zh: 我们的距离，我早算好了。
lines.en: I've already worked out our distance.
You blink first, and I move.

lines.zh: 我把帽子拉低，只露出下巴。
lines.en: I pull my hat low, showing only my chin.
You'd take me for a passer-by, wouldn't you.
I smile with my hands behind my back.
Folk round here are generous.

lines.zh: 这一下打掉了我半边帽子。
lines.en: That knocked half my hat away.

lines.zh: 我帽子掉了，捡起来再说。
lines.en: My hat's off. Let me get it first.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我直不起腰。
lines.en: That doubled me over.
I back toward the wall.
Blood on my shoes.
I grit my teeth and laugh.
Bad trade, this.
I hold my side and shuffle along.
Your hands are quicker than mine.
Not my day.
That thing in your hand glints nicely.
I take two steps closer and stop.

lines.zh: 好东西要收好，不然会丢。
lines.en: Valuables should be put away. They get lost.

lines.zh: 我扔出去的东西，会拐弯。
lines.en: What I throw curves.
This would fetch a fair price.
Hold it higher. I can't reach.
My hand's already out.

lines.zh: 你要是不小心掉了，我不客气。
lines.en: If you drop it carelessly, I won't be polite.
I've had my eye on this a while.

lines.zh: 你走远点，我怕我改主意。
lines.en: Walk on. I might change my mind.
Hey, watch where you're going!
My hand nearly went out.
That bump ruined the plan.

lines.zh: 我往后退，帽子压得更低。
lines.en: I step back, pulling my hat lower.

lines.zh: 你撞到我背后那包东西了。
lines.en: You hit the bag on my back.

lines.zh: 没事没事，我自己站不稳。
lines.en: No harm. I'm unsteady myself.
I come round from the far end of the alley.

lines.zh: 离我一步，我这行讲究距离。
lines.en: One step back. In my trade, distance matters.
You stepped on my heel.

lines.zh: 这一下，我只好换个目标。
lines.en: Now I'll have to pick a different mark.
In my line of work, we don't.

lines.zh: 你先把手上的东西给我。
lines.en: First, hand over what you're holding.
I'm not an honest sort.

lines.zh: 两个人分赃，总比一个人多。
lines.en: Two splitting loot beats one.
Are your hands quick? Let me see.
Come with me and you won't go hungry.
I don't care for clingy types.

lines.zh: 帽檐底下，谁也看不清谁。
lines.en: Under the brim, neither can see the other clearly.
After this job, we'll talk.

lines.zh: 你笑什么？我的帽子歪了？
lines.en: What's funny? Is my hat crooked?
A gold coin, dropped just right.
It goes straight up my sleeve.
Nobody saw that? Good.
I'm quick at picking things up.
Good grade. It'll fit up my sleeve.
I hide it in my hat's lining.
Taking what's dropped isn't stealing.
I bend over quite naturally.
This will feed me two days.
Stowed. Keep the face blank.
Your back is to me.
I'm behind the wall. No need to look.
You're alone on this road.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸口袋里的东西。
lines.en: I check what's in my pocket.

lines.zh: 我悄悄地往前挪了两步。
lines.en: I steal forward two paces.

lines.zh: 你的脚步很规律，好判断。
lines.en: Your steps are regular. Easy to read.
You'll do. Don't turn round.

lines.zh: 你背包带子松了，我看见了。
lines.en: Your pack strap's loose. I noticed.
No one about. Perfect.
I come up behind, lightly.
The wind's toward me. You shouldn't smell me.
Right. I'm going.
I hug the wall and follow, step by step.

lines.zh: 你绕了一圈，我又回到原位。
lines.en: You circled and I'm back where I was.

lines.zh: 我把帽檐压到眉毛下面。
lines.en: I pull my brim down past my brows.

lines.zh: 我在这棵树上等你过来。
lines.en: I'll wait in this tree for you to pass.
The slower you go, the less I hurry.

lines.zh: 我数着你的步数，还有十步。
lines.en: I count your steps. Ten to go.
The wind shifted. I need a new spot.

lines.zh: 你手放在武器上了，我等着。
lines.en: Your hand's on your weapon. I'll wait.
This stretch gives you nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，指间藏着东西。
lines.en: I lift my hand with something between the fingers.
Two paces more and I'm in reach.

lines.zh: 你听见了吗？那是我踩的。
lines.en: Did you hear that? That was me.
I shoulder into you from behind.
That one was for your hands.
One shove and I pull back.
I fling something at you.
Don't shout. There's no one to hear.
I pinch your wrist.

lines.zh: 这一踢，是为了让你松手。
lines.en: That kick was to loosen your grip.
You're steady again. Troublesome.
If I can't win, I slip away.
That counts as a wasted trip.
I show half a face from the alley.
Hat low, I look at no one.
Lots of corners in this village. Good for hiding.

lines.zh: 我把背后的东西整理了一下。
lines.en: I settle what's on my back.
First, work out which way the wind blows.
I squat by the wall a while.

lines.zh: 这地方的东西，看着都好拿。
lines.en: Everything here looks easy to take.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸腰间，东西还在。
lines.en: I check my belt. Still there.
The street's busy. No rush.
I'll wait for it to get darker.
Business is here.
Watch first, act after.
Flame catches my hat brim.

lines.zh: 我从树上滑下来，摔得不轻。
lines.en: I slip out of the tree and land badly.
I can't swim. I just flail.
The blast throws me across the road.
An arrow goes through my sleeve.

lines.zh: 那力量让我动不了，糟了。
lines.en: That force holds me still. Bad.

lines.zh: 两天没吃东西，腿都轻了。
lines.en: Two days without food and my legs feel hollow.
Lightning hits and I go stiff.

lines.zh: 虚空里没墙可贴，也没处躲。
lines.en: No wall to hug, nowhere to hide in the void.
